features_fixed_positive_direction.volume_acceleration: log(mean turnover last2 closed hours / mean preceding4 closed hours). Tests timing within6h after matching total6h volume level.
features_fixed_positive_direction.price_efficiency: Sum log close returns last6 closed hours /sum absolute log close returns over same hours; unavailable if denominator0. Higher=more orderly upward movement. This is not price change per aggressor buy notional.
features_fixed_positive_direction.close_retention_change: (Mean(high-close) preceding3 closed hours minus mean(high-close) last3 closed hours) /mean(high-low) preceding168 hours ending6hours ago. Higher=less retreat from each completed candle high recently. Does not infer intrabar path or actual max drawdown.

statistics: For all3 features report fixed-direction matched rank concordance, medians, per-event differences,7day-block98.3333% bootstrap intervals10000draws (nominal3-feature correction). A case is excluded for a feature if any member is nonfinite; no rematching. Exploratory candidate gate: >=20 matched cases,>=6 week blocks,concordance>=0.60 and lower>0.50 in BOTH periods. No forced winner, learned direction or threshold search. Reused controls, clustered events and reused periods limit inference.
decision: This step asks whether discrimination remains after matching strength and volume. Matching changes class proportions, so never call concordance or matched case fraction alert precision. Only if candidate gate passes consider a separate full-market causal replay at fixed alert budget; no automatic deployment or probability claim. No changes to earlier frozen experiments, production alerts, notifications or schedules.
